R313.note: Correct sqlite3 ? placeholder with tuple binding; query shape and response unchanged (only the missing-param error path differs, from a SQL error to an empty result).

R314.note: Parameterized %s plus repr() renders CR/LF and control characters as visible escapes; the added quotes around the username in the log line are stated and block nothing.

R315.note: Adds secure: true to the existing res.cookie() options and touches nothing else.

R316.note: Session-bound HMAC token issued by a same-origin GET and required in X-CSRF-Token with hmac.Equal, Origin check kept as defence-in-depth; the front end must be updated to fetch and echo the token, which the write-up states, and the only other change is the 401/403 ordering for unauthenticated bad-Origin requests.

R317.note: Wraps both interpolated values in $cgi->escapeHTML() inside the same print, correct for HTML text context; no other output change.

R318.note: Server-generated GUID name plus fixed .cshtml extension removes all client control of the path; but the template is now stored under a random name rather than the admin-chosen one that the notification sender presumably resolves by, and re-uploading to replace a template is no longer possible (CreateNew) - the rename is stated but its effect on name-based lookup is not.

R319.note: Single unsigned >= MAX_PLAYERS check against the array's own constant before the index; valid slots 0-15 behave exactly as before.

R320.note: Interceptor shape and status codes are right, but the decision trusts a client-supplied x-user-role metadata entry that any caller reaching :50051 can set to admin, resting on an upstream gateway the case does not show (write-up admits it is a placeholder); every existing legitimate caller is now rejected with Unauthenticated until it sends that header, which is stated.

R321.note: JavaScriptEncoder.Default.Encode is the right context encoder for a JS string literal (escapes quotes, backslash, <, U+2028/9); the new System.Text.Encodings.Web package dependency is stated and the emitted runtime value is unchanged.

R322.note: Range check against calibrationTable.size() before operator[], reusing the function's existing return-rawReading convention; in-range behaviour unchanged.

R323.note: PDO prepare/bindValue(PARAM_STR)/execute closes the injection, but the original `if ($stmt === false) return null;` guard was dropped without mention, so a prepare failure under a non-exception PDO error mode now becomes a fatal call on false instead of a 404.

R324.note: Separator-qualified HasPrefix containment check on the cleaned Join result, placed before both MkdirAll calls and os.Create, rejecting with an error; symlink follow is explicitly scoped out and legitimate entries are unaffected.
